verdict.rationale: The charter holder is unambiguous: Column N.A. describes itself as a nationally chartered bank, and its engineers confirm it is the issuing and sponsor bank. Customer accounts are FDIC insured bank accounts held at Column itself, so there is no middleware layer between the founder and the sponsor. What happens to customers if the platform fails is only implied by the FDIC-insured framing, not explained. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of failure and resolution scenarios, how pass-through FDIC coverage applies to FBO and sweep accounts, and independent corroboration of charter and insurance details.
